a.text: The bell tower's corridors are narrow, and the stone steps below my feet are slippery and wet. The stone walls are rough and feel so cold to the touch... just like the trees in that forest.
My footsteps echo in the hallway. What is there up ahead?
I'm the child of a Sankta and a Sarkaz. They all said that they have on me their...
I don't know. It was a word I've never heard.
But I remember how Rosella looked.
She looked down at me with a smile on her face. Her hands were clasped together like she was holding onto a treasure.
What did they... What did everyone want me to do? I still don't get it.
But now, I understand what it is that I should do the most and what it is that I want to do.
It doesn't matter if I'm a Sankta or a Sarkaz.
Goodbye, Mamma... Will you keep watching over me?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Ezell, your eleven o'clock.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Ngh!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: That was close!

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Come on, it's not like fighting is going to get us anywhere. Why don't we call it quits?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You really don't know how to listen, huh?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Ezell, I thought you were really worried about Cecelia. She might just be safer with me, you know?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Did you think I'd believe that?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I'm never one to lie.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Even if you're telling the truth, if that isn't what Cecelia wants, then there's no way!

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Sometimes I really think Andoain's giving me way more than I bargained for.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Stay focused, Ezell.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: No... Federico!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Can you feel it?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Well, look at that...

a.text: As though something is manifesting from nothingness.
A surge of power, pure power, nothing like any Originium Arts known to man.
An ancient construction is being awakened.
A forgotten sound is about to ring out far and wide.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Ezell, new directive: investigate the bell tower.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Leave the traitorous Legatus to me.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Your Holiness, what's going on?!

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Shh—

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Velliv, seal off the central sanctuary and halt all meetings.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: What is happening?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Did you know? My predecessor, the last Pope, had an interest in history.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: No...

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: I don't blame you. He was an amateur in the field. His writings were riddled with mistakes and hardly worthy of praise.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Rather than studying history, perhaps it's better to say that his interests lay in using history to let his imagination run wild.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: He was particularly fond of certain... romantic metaphors in his writings. Perhaps a little promiscuous for a history paper, but they did truly leave an impression on his readers.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: He said, 'History is a musical movement written by a shapeless titan in countless voices.'

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Going by his analogy, our titan musician seems to have started writing his next measure.
I breathe all the air out of my lungs before drawing a fresh breath.
I trip and fall to the ground, before climbing back up and running forward again.
I can feel that something is brewing.
The other side of the door at the top of the bell tower is where Cecelia is.
I open the door—
The frail girl is singing.
An ancient Sarkaz folk song.
She is singing from the bottom of her heart, so tenderly, with all her feelings.
I can only stand there, doing my best to hold my breath, to avoid disrupting the flow of her singing.
At a certain point, I realize I cannot hear anything anymore.
There is only the sound of bells, seemingly ringing across time.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Bells... from the Tower of Revelations...? That's impossible!

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: That bell has never rung!

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Except... except when...

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: When the first saint still walked the land.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: 'During the day, the Sankta looked up at the sky to find darkness shrouding even the sun. At night, the devil's army came and slaughtered countless Sankta. The Sankta lost much of their radiance.'

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: 'The saints said: follow me. Thus they rose. The saints said: listen to me. Thus, the bells began to ring.'

steps.name: Agitated Citizen
steps.text: 'The bells echoed throughout the wilderness, uniting all the Sankta.'

steps.name: Devout Citizen
steps.text: 'This is a revelation. This is an exhortation.'

steps.name: Agitated Citizen
steps.text: 'There will be light throughout the day, and it shall never be shrouded again.'

steps.name: Devout Citizen
steps.text: 'The saints said: build a city. It will be the Sankta's paradise.'

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: 'The saints said: this city shall be called Lateran.'

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: How...?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: The Tower of Revelations is one of the oldest structures in Laterano. No, according to the texts, the Tower of Revelations was here before there was a Laterano.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: And now the holy bells ring again...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: For our little Cecelia.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: But... why?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Perhaps the shapeless titan musician wanted some crescendos in his music, and he picked Lateran bells for his arrangement because he liked the sound.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Cardinal Velliv, you and I stand in this church at this moment. I wonder if that is good or bad.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Your Holiness, we must know immediately why the holy bells are ringing... No, no matter the reason, it is the responsibility of the Church to explain why and how it happened.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: With envoys from the nations gathered in Laterano, all of the attending representatives are now witnesses to this event. This could be an opportunity.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Go, Velliv. Inform the envoys that the Lateran bells ring for the first time in millennia, and this portends change. We must come together and prepare for the future.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: What about the Tower of Revelations, then...?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: We have waited long enough. Let's get to work.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Guide, did... did you know this was going to happen? What exactly is Cecelia...? S-She's mixed-race, but... is there some other secret about her?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: No, of course not. She's the Cecelia that both you and I know. She may come from a unique background, but there is no secret to her.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: It's just that, perhaps Laterano itself is thirsting for change, and Cecelia... she just so happened to be in the right place at the right time.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Or perhaps, she is actually the one who will end the thousand year conflict between the Sarkaz and the Sankta, and so Revelation came and the bells rang.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Of course, it could also just be a misunderstanding, a coincidence, a kind of black humor in the course of history.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: But we both know that the truth is never what's actually important.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Hmm... No matter what, this is an opportunity. If I have to say, it might even be proof that we are actually blessed.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: The Church is most likely putting all their attention on the envoys and the Tower of Revelations right now...

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: We'll pave the path forward for you. You need only walk it.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Andoain... the bells have started to ring.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: The bells belong to a child who is about to begin her journey.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You sound very relaxed. You've made your decision.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: My decision has never changed.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Even if you must give up everything?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Even if I must give up everything.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Is there any meaning in this?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Meaning... Meaning does not exist for nothing. All our choices merely conceive it, mold it, and give it the chance to descend upon us.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I get it now.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I hope you'll find your peace.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Patia, what you just said goes against our original goal.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: All men are cornerstones, and the roads that we lay are paved for those who follow us.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: I must see His Holiness right now!

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: Gun-Knight Talvadore, His Holiness is praying right now. No one can see him.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: But!

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: Please understand.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: An explosion?

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: Probably another one of the people's pranks.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: No! The explosion came from the envoys' village. We stopped handing out approvals for explosive activities there!

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors
steps.text: G...Gun-Knight Talvadore, the envoys' village is under attack, and there have been multiple fires and explosions all across the city!

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: It's the Astray! They can't sit still now that the holy bells have sounded, can they?

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors
steps.text: There are Gun-Knights stationed in the envoys' village, but... after the ambush and explosions started, the envoys started demanding more Gun-Knights to protect them.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Dammit, why now of all times?!

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Cardinal Velliv!

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: The bells of the Tower of Revelations are ringing. This is the holiest moment in Lateran history. We even get to share this with the first 'Summit of Nations' and the envoys of all the lands. How joyous.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Yet the heretics' remnants are taking the opportunity to sow chaos. They plot to disrupt the conference and overshadow Laterano's radiance.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Gun-Knight Talvadore, by order of the Apostle Himself, the Pope, you are to go to the envoys' village and defend them alongside the Gun-Knights there, thus ensuring the Summit of Nations will commence as planned.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I will accompany you.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Very well. Your Eminence, if I may...

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: I'm sure you've noticed as much, but the energy that's surging from the Tower of Revelations...

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Watch your words, Reverend Gun-Knight.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: That is glory itself.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Lemuen, did he do this?!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Maybe...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You're still going to cover for him?!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Fiammetta, come here.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: What for?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Come here.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I shouldn't have said what I said the other day.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Let go of me...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Not until you forgive me.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I AM mad at you.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: But there's something else I'm even angrier about.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: And it might just be me.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I want you to trust me on one thing, Fiammetta.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: If he really wanted to do harm to Laterano... I'd never forgive him.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Then what is it he's trying to do?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Maybe... He's just asking a question.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Of who?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: His Holiness.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: And what is he asking him?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: A question that the Sankta must never ask.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You can't be more specific?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm not entirely sure myself, you see... This question has probably been bothering him deep in his mind for a long time... He hasn't ever told me about it. I've just got a hunch.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: But it's true. What happened eight years ago has something to do with the question.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Wait... so, Mostima, you knew about this?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Of course not. I'm not Lemuen.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: She might understand him. Me, though? I didn't think he was worthy, that's all.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: If you ask me, he's a poor little guy. And I have something more important to take care of, so let's leave it at that.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: How come it feels like you're ticking me off even more than Lemuen?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You and I are different. I did everything I could. And you... I'm guessing you would probably rather it was me, right?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Lemuen, what else do you know? Tell me.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I thought you didn't want to hear any of it?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I have to hear to find out.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Cecelia La Porta, by order of the Apostle Himself, the Pope, I am here to protect you.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Because the bells started ringing?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Are they ringing because of me?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: I cannot say.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Please follow me to the Basilica at once.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: It's okay, Mister Ezell. Don't worry.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Let's go.
